opening.argument: The presentation sets out a tiered payment structure: joining level 1 costs 10 BUSD, divided between X3 and X4, with levels opened one by one. It explains that a third participant’s payment can go to an upline rather than the participant’s wallet, and links a full payout to bringing a member into the system. The speaker urges viewers to activate a level, claims that raising a 10-dollar level will yield $112, and asks them to share the video. The displayed Forsage levels and activation controls, alongside partner, profit, and referral-link figures, reinforce a model built around tiered participation and recruitment commissions. The figures are not verified, and a separate graphic challenges the scam characterization; neither removes the promotional claims presented here.
